svg.title: An image, rebuilt from 150 triangles by gradient descent
svg.desc: Soft rasterization in Rust, seed 0, 797 steps on one CPU core. Left: the 176 by 176 px target. Middle: 150 translucent triangles in paint order on the fitted background. Right: recorded loss on a logarithmic scale; loss fell 503× (best at step 546). First loss 0.014733868, best loss 2.9270554e-05, last loss 3.4631666e-05. The magenta dot marks the best scene's step. Triangles appear in paint order over eight seconds as the loss curve is revealed; the complete scene holds for six seconds, then fades for one second. The assembly reveals the recorded best scene, rather than intermediate optimization scenes.
